input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "solicit", "develop" and "will not / shall not" obligations turned up no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant binding AP. To the contrary, Section 1 (p0001) expressly confirms the arrangement is non-exclusive and that AP remains free to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties. The only "will not" obligations on AP are ordinary licence-use restrictions on the Kubient platform (p0025 — no third-party access, no derivative works) and standard confidentiality undertakings (p0060–p0061), which are not restrictive covenants on our business. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is needed.
